customManagers.description: Version pins in the Makefile, each annotated with a `# renovate:` comment. Renovate ships no Makefile manager, so without this they drift silently.

packageRules.description: helm-unittest tags are <helm version>-<plugin version>, six numbers where regex versioning compares five: the helm version, then the plugin's minor and patch. shortcut: a plugin major bump within one helm version sorts low; read such a PR by hand.
